description: EX-1: the per-project third-party lock <project>/benchmarks/project/third_party/lock.json. It pins the project's own Python wheels (they enter the project bench image under /opt/project-python) and source archives (review material; they never enter an image). Each item binds its parts, provenance record, notice and license record by sha256. bench.json binds this file by sha256 (bench_model.project_bench). Every path is relative to benchmarks/project/ and lies under third_party/. A change needs the approver (safety/protected-paths.json project_protected). FW-HOOK (fact F14): additive forms. A retained row binds upstream files kept without their archive (for example selected headers of a source release); files of a wheel or source row binds more upstream files of that row; a provenance or notice record may bind its size. The privacy hook (.githooks/personal_info_check.py) exempts the content of a file only when this lock of the same revision binds its exact path, sha256 and size in a row whose origin URL matches $defs.exempt_origin_url (a wheel part only under third_party/wheels/ in a PyPI wheel row); no row binds this lock itself. T6-R2: a wheel row of tracked parts may declare host_members, its few members above the container file bound (at most 4, each at most 50331648 bytes); the host writes them into the image layer from the verified wheel bytes. T6-R3: a wheel row may declare notice_member, the exact wheel member path of its license file.

bytes.description: FW-HOOK: the record size; the privacy hook exempts a provenance or notice record only with its size

oneOf.description: EX1-A01: only in a framework fixture project under tests/fixtures/ (tools/project_third_party.py check_lock)

source_dir.description: first-party fixture wheels only: the tracked source directory that project_third_party.build_source_wheel turns into the wheel bytes (parts is then empty)

notice_member.description: T6-R3: the exact wheel member path of the license file, below the dist-info directory or below <dist>.data/data/ (tools/project_third_party.py notice_member_rules). The extraction job reads exactly that member (at most 1048576 bytes) as the notice; without it the job searches the dist-info directory

host_members.description: T6-R2: the members of this wheel above the container file bound (33554432 bytes), each with its exact size and sha256. The extraction job hashes each one in bounded chunks and never writes it; the host streams it from the verified wheel bytes into the layer. A wheel of tracked parts only (tools/project_third_party.py HOST_MEMBERS_MAX)

host_member.description: T6-R2: one host member: its path inside the wheel (not a repository path), its size above the container file bound and at most the host member bound (tools/project_third_party.py HOST_MEMBER_MAX_BYTES), and its sha256

files.description: FW-HOOK: more upstream files of a row (for example license texts), each bound by path, sha256 and bytes

retained.description: FW-HOOK: upstream files kept without their upstream archive (the provenance record names the archive and its digest); they never enter an image

exempt_origin_url.description: FW-HOOK: the upstream allowlist of the privacy hook (UPSTREAM_URL in .githooks/personal_info_check.py; a unit test keeps both equal): PyPI files, GitHub release downloads and archives, Boost release archives. An origin URL outside it is valid in the lock, but the hook exempts no file of that row.
